FVTTATLAS.Settings.ShowStartupNotice.Hin: When enabled, show the GM a notification after the world loads. This is a diagnostic only.
FVTTATLAS.Notifications.Ready: FVTT Atlas Navigation: Module loaded successfully.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.GridUnavailable: This Scene has no usable Grid distance or pixel size. Configure them in the native Grid tab; Atlas has no separate distance override.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SceneGridSaveHint: Atlas always uses native Scene Grid measurement. Save any Grid tab changes first. Future road distances will be measured with Foundry's own grid path measurement, including hex and gridless rules.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Title: Roads
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Active: This Scene has an Atlas road network.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.EmptyStatus: No Atlas roads configured for this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Drawing: Click map points to draw a road. Endpoints can snap to nearby junctions or road interiors, but connecting requires confirmation when finishing. Hold Alt while placing an endpoint to keep it disconnected. Enter finishes, Backspace removes a point, Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.NoRoads: Use the + button to draw your first road on the viewed Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DeleteWarning: Delete this road? Existing junction points will be preserved.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.StartNotice: Road drawing started. Click map points, then Finish Road (or Enter). Any endpoint connections will ask for confirmation before saving.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.LegacyHint: These roads were saved with pre-0.2.5 canvas coordinates. First set Scene padding to the value where the roads visibly align with the background image. Then anchor them once. No roads will move at the moment you anchor.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Anchor: Anchor legacy roads to map image
FVTTATLAS.Roads.AnchorWarning: Confirm that the roads are currently aligned with the Scene background. This converts their saved coordinates using the image's current origin. It does not guess the padding used when roads were drawn. Back up your world if unsure. Continue?
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Anchored: Legacy Atlas roads anchored to the Scene image. You can now change Scene padding without shifting them relative to the map.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Redraw: Redraw road bends (keeps both junctions fixed)
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Reshaping: Redraw intermediate bends between the existing endpoints. Finish without points makes a straight road. Enter finishes; Backspace undoes; Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.ReshapeNotice: Bend editing started. Click intermediate points between the fixed junctions, then Save Bends. Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.OrganizeHint: This Scene has older road data. Organize it once to enable draggable road points and named-road groups. Geometry and segment IDs stay unchanged.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.OrganizeWarning: Back up your world first. This explicitly upgrades v0.2.5 roads to named-road groups. Every existing segment keeps its ID and shape. Roads with matching names are NOT automatically merged; use Merge on connected roads afterward. Continue?
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Organized: Atlas road data organized. Existing shapes and junctions were preserved.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.EditPoints: Edit road points (drag bends and shared junctions)
FVTTATLAS.Roads.EditNotice: Drag white bends or gold graph nodes to edit. Shift-click a white bend to promote it; Shift-click a gold two-section pass-through to turn it into a bend. Alt/Option-click a white bend to remove it, a junction between different roads to detach your road, or a same-road branch to choose one section to disconnect. Double-click a line to insert a bend. Use Save Points, Undo or Cancel Edits.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.PointEditHint: Drag white bends or gold graph points. Shift-click a white bend to make a graph junction; Shift-click an eligible gold two-section pass-through to revert to a white shaping bend. Alt/Option-click a white bend to delete it, a shared junction to detach the selected road, or a same-road branch to choose one arm to disconnect. Double-click to add a bend. Undo (Ctrl/Cmd+Z), Save Points or Cancel Edits.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.MergeWarning: Merge {from} into {to}? This keeps every segment and junction, but removes the separate name {from} from the list.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.Merged: Connected roads merged under one name.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.ConnectNewWarning: This will connect the new road to existing road junctions. Each road keeps its own name and identity; no named roads will be merged. Proceed?
FVTTATLAS.Roads.ConnectExistingWarning: This will connect the moved junction to an existing road. All roads already meeting at the moved junction will share the new connection. Each road keeps its own name; no named roads will be merged. Proceed?
FVTTATLAS.Roads.ConnectDeclined: Connection not created. To draw a disconnected endpoint, start again and hold Alt while placing it.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.SegmentCountHint: Internal graph edges, split at junctions. This is not the number of visually separate roads or paths.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachWarning: This separates only the selected named road from this shared junction. Other roads stay connected to each other and remain in place. The selected road will have an independent control point at the same location until you drag it. No road will be deleted or renamed.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachedNotice: Junction detached in the draft. Drag its gold point to relocate it, then Save Points to persist.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.NotShared: This node is not a multi-road junction or a same-road branch. Shift-click a two-section pass-through to make a white bend.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachBranchTitle: Disconnect one section of this road?
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachBranchWarning: Several sections of this named road meet here. Choose the single arm to disconnect. Other arms and the road name stay unchanged. Nothing is deleted.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachBranchAfter: The freed endpoint initially overlaps the original junction. Drag the gold point away, then optionally Shift-click the remaining two-section junction to make it a white bend. Undo or Cancel Edits can reverse this before saving.
FVTTATLAS.Roads.DetachBranchNotice: One section disconnected in the draft. Drag its overlapping gold endpoint away, then Save Points.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Title: Waypoints
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Add: Add waypoint on an existing road
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Hint: Waypoints are real graph junctions, including road endpoints. Click +, then click a road to create a junction. During Edit Points, Shift-click a white bend to promote it. Crossings stay disconnected unless you explicitly join them.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Picking: Click the interior of an existing road to create a junction. Escape or Cancel Drawing stops picking.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.StartNotice: Waypoint placement started. Click an existing road to stage a new gold junction, then Save Points. Escape cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.StagedNotice: Junction staged on the selected road. Save Points to persist, or Undo/Cancel Edits.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.PromotedNotice: White bend converted into a draft gold junction. Drag it toward another road to request a confirmed connection, then Save Points.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.ClickRoad: Click a saved Atlas road to place a waypoint.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.AlreadyJunction: That point is already a graph junction. Click a road interior to add another.
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Editing: New junction staged. Adjust its gold handle if needed, then Save Points; Undo and Cancel Edits are available here.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.Title: Junctions
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.Hint: Only branching or shared junctions appear here. Endpoints and ordinary same-road subdivisions stay editable in Roads. Click + then a road to stage a junction; drag the gold point onto another road and confirm. In Edit Points, Shift-click a gold two-section pass-through to make a white bend. Alt/Option-click a same-road branch to choose one arm to disconnect. Crossings remain separate unless joined.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.Picking: Click an existing road interior to stage a graph junction. Esc or Cancel Drawing stops picking.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.Editing: New graph node staged. Drag it to a connecting road if desired; Save Points, Undo and Cancel Edits are available here.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.None: No branching junctions match this filter. Single-road bend and end handles remain available through Edit Points.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.StartNotice: Junction placement started. Click an existing road, then drag its new gold node to a connecting road (with confirmation) or Save Points. Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.PromotedNotice: White bend promoted to a gold graph node in the draft. Drag toward another road to confirm a connection; then Save Points.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.DemotedNotice: Single-road pass-through node converted into a white shaping bend in the draft. Undo or Save Points to finish.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.ClickRoad: Click a saved Atlas road to stage a junction.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.AlreadyJunction: This is already a graph point. Click a road interior to add another.
FVTTATLAS.Junctions.StagedNotice: Junction staged. Drag its gold handle to connect another road, then Save Points (or Undo/Cancel Edits).
FVTTATLAS.Waypoints.Future: Reserved for named places along roads: tolls, checkpoints, landmarks, hidden events and native Journal/Note links. Waypoints are not shaping bends or road junctions; they will be implemented in a later milestone.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Title: Terrain Regions
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Hint: Link existing Foundry Regions for future Atlas terrain previews. Geometry, elevation and Behaviors are configured in Foundry's native Region tools. Atlas does not change movement costs.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Refresh: Refresh Region list after native Region changes
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Choose: Choose an existing native Region to link
FVTTATLAS.Regions.NoNative: This Scene has no native Regions. Create one using Foundry's Regions canvas layer, then refresh this list.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.None: No Regions linked to Atlas yet. Use + to link an existing Region.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.NoAvailable: No unlinked native Regions are available in this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Hidden: Native Region is hidden; its Behaviors are inactive.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.UnlinkWarning: Unlink {name} from Atlas? Its native Region shapes, elevation, visibility and Behaviors will remain unchanged and may still affect actual token movement.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Unlinked: Region unlinked from Atlas; Foundry's native Region remains unchanged.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.Missing: That native Region is missing or cannot be edited. Refresh the Atlas list.
FVTTATLAS.Regions.InvalidHint: One or more Regions have unsupported Atlas link flags. Atlas will not overwrite or unlink them. Inspect the Region flag or update the module before making changes.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Title: Checkpoints
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Hint: Named checkpoints mark meaningful positions on a road: elevation, tolls, watchposts or future encounters. They are different from white shaping bends and gold routing junctions. Checkpoints do not create native Regions, terrain effects or events in this version.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Picking: Click a saved road endpoint, junction or interior section. Choose the named road if multiple roads meet there, then enter a checkpoint name and optional elevation. Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.ClickRoad: Click a saved Atlas road to place a checkpoint.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Name: Checkpoint name
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Elevation: Elevation (meters above sea level; negative below)
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.ElevationHint: Leave elevation empty when unknown. This height describes a road location, NOT the Foundry Region elevation range or an automatic difficult-terrain rule.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Saved: Checkpoint saved on its named road.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.StartNotice: Click an existing road point or section to place a checkpoint; Esc cancels.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.DeleteWarning: Remove checkpoint {name}? Its road node and geometry will remain unchanged.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.Removed: Checkpoint removed; road geometry is unchanged.
FVTTATLAS.Checkpoints.None: No named checkpoints match the selected roads. Click + to place one.
